title: Digital lending rules — how to borrow safely from apps
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: RBI's digital lending rules require that loans be disbursed directly into the borrower's bank account and repaid directly to the lender's account — not through a third-party app wallet. The lender must give you a Key Fact Statement showing the APR, all fees and the total cost before you sign, and a cooling-off period lets you exit a loan early by repaying the principal and proportionate interest. Only use apps that name an RBI-regulated bank or NBFC as the lender; RBI publishes a list of verified digital lending apps. Warning signs of illegal loan apps: access to your contacts and photos, very short tenure, hidden fees, threats, and harassment or shaming of your contacts. If harassed, do not pay extra, take screenshots, report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in and file a complaint at the RBI's Complaint Management System (cms.rbi.org.in).
summary_hinglish: RBI rules ke hisaab se loan seedha tumhare bank account mein aana chahiye, aur Key Fact Statement mein APR aur sab fees dikhne chahiye. Sirf RBI-regulated bank/NBFC wale apps use karo. Contacts/photos ka access maangna, dhamki aur contacts ko sharm dilana illegal apps ke sign hain; 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.
summary_hi: RBI नियमों के अनुसार लोन सीधे आपके बैंक खाते में आना चाहिए और कुल लागत व APR वाला की फैक्ट स्टेटमेंट मिलना चाहिए। केवल RBI-विनियमित बैंक/NBFC वाले ऐप इस्तेमाल करें। संपर्क/फोटो एक्सेस, धमकी और संपर्कों को शर्मिंदा करना अवैध ऐप के संकेत हैं; 1930 या cybercrime.gov.in पर रिपोर्ट करें।
